name: @cyclone-ui/color-compositions
description: An animated display component reproducing Ellsworth Kelly's "Colors for a Large Wall" as a grid of colored panels. The grid fits as many `panelSize` panels as the component's dimensions allow, tiling the painting when larger. Pairs of differently colored panels swap places on an `interval` (in milliseconds) with a short color fade; `0` or a reduced-motion preference holds the panels still.
